reviews.title: Terrible App - Waste of Money
reviews.text:
I subscribed to ViX Premium in the U.S. specifically to watch Lionel Messi’s last soccer game, and the app was completely useless. It repeatedly told me to log out of two devices, even though I was only using it on my TV. Then it kept claiming I had no internet connection, despite my Wi-Fi working perfectly fine.

I paid for a service I couldn’t even use. It’s extremely frustrating when an app charges customers but fails to deliver what they’re paying for. ViX seriously needs to fix these technical issues and improve its service. I would not recommend this app based on my experience.

reviews.title: Terrible streaming service
reviews.text:
The app performs poorly, and the customer service is just as frustrating. The service is already slow in general, but during major games it becomes almost unusable. Multiple times, the stream has stopped and displayed a message telling me to close the app on other devices — even though no other devices were using the account at all.

What makes the experience worse is the customer service. Instead of trying to resolve the issue, it feels like they focus on defending why the service is failing. Conversations with support feel more like talking to a lawyer explaining away problems rather than a team genuinely trying to help customers.

At this point, it honestly feels like the company uses these pop-ups to manage bandwidth because their servers can’t handle the traffic during big events. Overall, the app is unreliable, frustrating to use, and backed by poor customer support.

reviews.title: Operational
reviews.text:
I really enjoy using ViX because the content is genuinely great. The programs, series, and variety available on the platform are excellent and make it worth watching.

However, the overall user experience is extremely frustrating. The app frequently logs me out—sometimes once or twice a week—which becomes very annoying over time. On top of that, basic functions like fast-forwarding often cause the app to freeze. When that happens, it can take a long time before things work normally again, which really disrupts the experience.

I understand that updates and system maintenance are necessary, but there needs to be better communication with users—especially those paying for an annual subscription. Customers deserve to know when issues are happening and what is being done to fix them.

At this point, these ongoing technical problems are unacceptable. Either the issues need to be resolved quickly, or there should be clear communication and options for customers, including refunds or pauses in billing when the service isn’t working properly.

reviews.title: ⭐️ 1 estrella – Muy decepcionado con ViX Premium too many ads
reviews.text:
La aplicación ViX se cierra inesperadamente demasiadas veces. Aunque estoy pagando el paquete Premium, sigo viendo anuncios constantemente, cuando claramente dice que con Premium no debería haber comerciales. Y a pesar de que mi conexión es perfecta, la app sigue fallando.

Cada vez que la aplicación se cierra sola, no regresa directamente al juego; primero me vuelve a mostrar más y más comerciales.

Esto demuestra que no les importa la experiencia del usuario ni lo que estés viendo, solo que los anuncios se reproduzcan. Y no solo dentro de la aplicación… durante los partidos también agregan demasiados comerciales y marcas.

Después de tanta frustración, cancelé mi suscripción. Muy mala experiencia.

The ViX app keeps closing unexpectedly way too often. Even though I’m paying for the Premium package, I still get constant ads, even though it clearly states that Premium users shouldn’t get commercials. And even though my internet connection is perfect, the app continues to fail.

Every time the app shuts down on its own, it doesn’t take me back to the game right away; instead, it shows me more and more ads.

This shows that they don’t care about the viewer’s experience or what you’re trying to watch—what matters to them is pushing as many ads as possible. And it’s not just inside the app… during the matches they also insert too many commercials and brand placements.

After all the frustration, I canceled my subscription. Very poor experience.

reviews.title: Technical issues for a big platform
reviews.text: I’ve been a user of this app for a good time now and I can go over many mistakes that this “big platform” has. Don’t get me wrong, it’s great when everything is going well, but compared to other apps this is number one at least for me that has the most issues. Whether I’m being consistently logged out of my account or not being able to watch any series from this app. I’ve had an issue for almost a month now and I’ve tried everything but the problem remains, I haven’t been able to watch anything on my smart tv due to the app not being able to load, I would hope that I receive technical support with this issue sometime soon or even best a full refund.

reviews.title: Fails its promises
reviews.text: The worst app I’ve ever had to pay for. When I PAY for a subscription I expect the APP to work FLAWLESSLY. VIX always freezes, always has connections problems, even when connected to the best and most powerful internet. The app lags and desyncs an ungodful amount of times in one sitting. I couldn’t even enjoy a soccer game without about 15 blank black screens, then before the game I was already watching decides to make me watch another THREE ADS!!! Trash app. The app crashes RELIGIOUSLY. If you were wanting to distress from the day, buckle up because you’ll be livid by the time you finally make it to your destination in-APP, oh wait it just Crashed AGAIN! Save your money.

reviews.text: I’ve been trying to use the app on my tv for the last hour and a half and it keeps telling me I’m logged in too many screen and then it kicks me out and I can’t watch anything and the funny thing. THE TV IS THE ONLY LLACE I HAVE THE APP ON! The tv is the only time we have used this app and for some reason now it won’t work and keeps locking me out. I’ve logged in using just the website on my phone and tried airplay and it still won’t work. I thought maybe the airplay was my tv, nope! It works for all the other ones except for this app. It’s a horrible app that I pay for but can’t even use! If anyone was thinking about getting this service, don’t cuz you’ll be just throwing money away on something you can sometimes use on your phone and ONLY on your phone.
